description: A consortium of European industrial firms and research labs achieves a breakthrough in energy-efficient AI training, leveraging novel sparsity techniques and custom silicon designs developed under the InvestAI Gigafactories program. The result, dubbed 'Project Osmosis', demonstrates a 40% reduction in power per training step compared to current global standards. While not matching frontier capability, it proves that EU-led innovation can decouple performance from energy intensity, attracting interest from climate-focused investors and softening local opposition to data centre expansion in Sweden and Spain.
